text:
Noah (Customer Success): quick check-in for Glenview Health private onboarding. Two outstanding items: cross-account IAM role + long-term audit retention. cc @Tara @Evan @Sofia
Tara (CSE): Hi! We mostly need the role ARN and the preferred log sink. Do you want logs to stay in eu-central-1? Any compliance notes about immutability?
Evan (NetEng): Networking note: prefer VPC endpoint + NATless egress. We'll need your allowed egress FQDNs for Splunk collector and the CIDR for our peering route if you choose peering. PrivateLink preferred if you want no route table changes.
Sofia (Security): Compliance flagged: Glenview needs 10y retention, WORM/immutability, and an auditable KMS rotation every 180 days. That means a CMK in their account with a key policy allowing Redwood's write role and iam:PassRole for deployment service.
Tara (CSE): Example trust snippet we'll need in the role (terraform):
```
data "aws_iam_policy_document" "trust" {
  statement {
    actions = ["sts:AssumeRole"]
    principals {
      type        = "AWS"
      identifiers = ["arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-audit-writer"]
    }
  }
}
```
Keep the role name predictable so our automation can detect it.
Noah (Customer Success): Also FYI renewal team flagged this as a potential risk if we can't produce encrypt/rotation evidence before the contract review next month. Let's try to lock the CMK + bucket config this week.
InfraBot: task created: "glenview-audit-policy-221000" assigned to Tara (CSE) — https://infra.redwood.internal/tickets/221000
Evan (NetEng): If you want PrivateLink, here's the resource name we need from you: com.amazonaws.eu-central-1.s3 (or private-api name for Splunk). Otherwise provide the NAT egress IPs and we'll add routes.
Sofia (Security): For KMS policy, we'll want this in the PR: allow: kms:CreateGrant, kms:ListGrants, kms:DescribeKey for the redwood service principal; deny:
kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion from all non-admins. We'll review the exact wording.
Tara (CSE): Action items I captured:
- Glenview: create CMK + paste key ARN here (due EOD)
- Provide audit bucket ARN + prefix (eu-central-1)
- Provide Splunk collector FQDN or bucket-forwarder details
- Post short GRC note for rotation policy (for renewal team)
If all done we can run a dry-run Friday morning.
Noah (Customer Success): I'll nudge their infra lead and ask for the ARNs. Also capturing feedback: Glenview requested clearer diagrams in the enablement docs around key delegation and the flow for audit exports  we should add that to next week's enablement sync.
Evan (NetEng): small note: if you use object lock retention >365d, S3 lifecycle transitions to IA are disabled. That may affect cost estimates.
Sofia (Security): scheduling: if we get ARNs tonight, can do a 20min bridge tomorrow 09:30 CET to finalize policies.
Noah (Customer Success): Confirmed. I'll push a reminder. Thanks team :rocket:
